  Exam Date & Time: 06-Dec-2024 (02:30 PM - 05:30 PM)  
  
  
  MANIPAL ACADEMY OF HIGHER EDUCATION  
  MIT BLR - BTech V Semester - End Semester Examination - Nov / Dec -2024  
  Scientific Thinking and Creativity [PHY-4322]  
  Marks: 50                                                                              Duration: 180 mins.  
  PART-A  
  Answer all the questions.  
  1)           What are the challenges with deductivism, and how does this affect the progression of  
  scientific research and practical applications?  
  (5)  
  A)  
  B)      Using an appropriate example, explain the fallibility of the phrase "Seeing is believing." (3)  
  
  C)      How does common knowledge differ from scientific knowledge in reliability and  
  Objectivity?                                                                               (2)  
  
  2)           Does science advance in a steady line or phases? Explain Thomas Kuhn's idea of  
  scientific revolutions with appropriate examples.  
  (5)  
  A)  
  B)      Explain why inductive generalization is considered circular reasoning.                     (3)  
  C)      What is the difference between the normative and descriptive procedures in scientific  
  methods for generating knowledge?                                                          (2)  
  
  3)           What is the systematicity theory of scientific knowledge? Explain using real-life  
  examples.  
  (5)  
  A)  
  B)      Using appropriate examples, explain how descriptions are more systematic in scientific  
  knowledge than other forms of knowledge.                                                   (3)  
  
  C)      What are the characteristics of significant anomalies?                                     (2)  
  4)           What is artificial creativity, and can machines be considered creative? Provide  
  supporting reasoning for your answers.  
  (5)  
  A)  
  B)      Explain the Geneplore creative process, examining its elements and discussing how they  
  contribute to finding creative solutions.                                              (3)  
  
  C)      Explain the exploratory creativity using appropriate examples.                             (2)

  5)            Analyze the societal reaction to emerging technologies and explore the reasons behind  
  society's reluctance to embrace these innovations.  
  (5)  
  A)  
  B)       Do opponents of technology hold valid concerns? Support your response with relevant  
  examples.                                                                                (3)  
  
  C)       Explain the utilitarian theory of ethics.                                                (2)
